interactions.note: The epitope of nanobody Nb51H01 on a TMEM175 channel from Marivirga tractuosa (MtTMEM175) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. The Nb was engineered by fusing an N-terminally truncated Maltose Binding Protein (MBP) to its C-terminus which greatly improved diffraction and was termed macrobody (Mb51H01). The lysosomal potassium channel MtTMEM175 T38A mutant was soaked with zinc.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.2 angstroms
